messages:
Mara: Quick design pass — action rows in dashboard table: keyboard focus order feels off when you open the overflow (⋯) menu. Prototype: https://figma.com/proto/redwood/action-rows-2026 (keyboard nav flow)

Jonah: repro steps? I couldn't reproduce earlier. What browser/os?

Mara: macOS + Chrome. Steps: Tab to row, press Enter to open menu, menu items highlight but pressing Tab jumps out of the table to the global toolbar instead of hitting next menu item. Happens on compact table only.

Sam: likely focus management bug. We render menu outside the DOM flow with position:absolute + overflow hidden on parent; when we open we rely on tabindex on menu items but maybe they aren't inserted into DOM order for Chrome to follow.

Leah: we need to be careful — users expect predictable Tab order. Also product asks that row-level click remains keyboard-accessible (Enter on row). We can't break that.

Jonah: proposal: on open, programmatically call menu.firstElementChild.focus() and set aria-expanded=true on trigger. Use :focus-visible styles for keyboard ring. Also ensure menu DOM node is placed after trigger in DOM order even if visually absolute-positioned.

Mara: that addresses the keyboard, but we also have an a11y issue with making whole row clickable + having multiple interactive children. axe flagged "interactive element is not focusable" on .row when we added role=button without tabindex.

Sam: yep — either give row tabindex=0 or avoid role=button. My preference: avoid a single row role when there are independent controls; instead make a separate visually-fullwidth link overlay for the list variant only. For tables keep explicit action controls.

Mara: agreement: keep table rows with discrete actions. For list/list-item variant we can surface an entire row hit target. We'll update tokens: add a 6px padding token for icon-only actions so touch target meets 44px.

Mara: CSS snippet I'm proposing:
```
.action-btn {
  padding: 6px; /* token: spacing.icon-action */
  min-width: 44px; /* ensure 44px touch */
  border-radius: 8px;
}
.action-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.menu-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] + .menu { /* keep menu after trigger in DOM */
  display: block;
}
```

Jonah: looks good. Minor: use .menu:focus-within to keep open on keyboard nav if we add a small delay on blur to avoid accidental close when moving between items.

Leah: copy nits — menu trigger label currently says "More actions". Can we change to "Actions"? Also SR should read the row name: aria-label="Actions for {{rowName}}" so screen reader users know the context.

Mara: prefer shorter "Actions" visually; agree on SR labeling.

Sam: I ran axe locally — current failures: 1) interactive element not focusable (row), 2) insufficient touch target for icon-only button (0.5 rem short). After applying padding token fixes and focus management PR, axe clean.

Mara: plan: Sam will open PR with these changes (JS focus management, token update, SR label), Jonah will review, I'll verify in the prototype and close loop with product on copy.

Jonah: I'll add unit/integration tests: keyboard nav for open menu, focus stays on first item, Tab cycles through menu then returns to next cell. Also add e2e with VoiceOver on Mac if possible.

DesignBot: a11y-checker: please run CI axe once PR is open — tag @Mara @Sam for failures.

Leah: :thumbsup: thanks all — this should fix the weird tabbing and keep mobile hit targets sane.
